name: Yakiniku Kuripuupi
source:
Numerous crises hit well-established yakiniku restaurant "Kuripuupi"! Most of waitresses and one male employee leave the establishment. Can you get your customers back with just four waitress girls in uniforms? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
老字号烤肉店“库利普皮”遭遇重重危机！
大部分女服务员与一名男员工离职。
仅凭4名身穿制服的女服务员，你能让顾客回流吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
